title: lifr 0.1.1
text: Fixes September 2026 code review (issues #1-#20). Behaviour changes worth knowing: lif_read() / lif_import(): trailing delimiters data lines longer shift every column (#1); digits-colour codes keep leading zeros (#2); header-log omitted warning instead aborting import (#3); read_locations() aliases (x, y, id, …) never overwrite canonical column (#4). hp_correction() indexes per-boring water_table name even boring factor (#5); new_lif_data() converts factor borings character. edit history now survives [, rbind() (histories concatenate), dplyr verbs (#6). merge() as_tibble() still drop . n_rows_changed counts readings whose value changed, readings inside window, re-applying edit records 0 (#7). editors’ default bottom now Inf rather 1000. process_site(corrections = list(hp = FALSE)) skips correction (#8). failing summary, chart, report step raises warning logged failed even quiet = TRUE (#11). NA-depth readings left alone every editor; lif_zero_shallow() also masks readings ground surface; keep plan row needs least one bound (#9). Markdown report escapes paths names, Windows paths longer break PDF (#10). logs PDF written Markdown links removed fails; unrenderable figures leave visible placeholder (#18). TinyTeX installs PATH detected. compat_rename_legacy() warns every collision, per session (#12). lif_simulate() restores caller’s RNG state (#13). qc_compare() pairs repeated depths correctly; re_feet() averages repeated depths; lif_downsample() keeps NA-depth rows; summarize_lif() handles 0-row frame reports unbinned readings (#14). report’s change detection matches readings depth (#15). boring_map() gains min_extent one boring collinear transect keeps sensible window, labels formatted per element (#16). chart_ec_histogram() leaves outliers histogram states caption (#17). HTML report proper tab header roles, keyboard-sortable tables, hash handler throw (#19). theme_lifr() honours base_size; depth_slice_map(agg_fn=) receives plain vector; basemap featureless check ignores alpha plane (#20).

title: lifr 0.1.0
text: Initial public release. lif_read() / lif_import() read .lif.dat.txt / .csv logs (modern header layout headerless legacy 11- 16-column layouts), keep every source column, join locations table via read_locations(). Editors audit trail: lif_editor(), lif_editor_bulk(), lif_keep(), lif_zero_shallow(), lif_zero_below_threshold(), lif_apply_edits(), edit_history() accessors. Processing: hp_correction(), re_feet(), lif_downsample(). summarize_lif() QA statistics. Plots: lif_plot(), lif_plot_all(), lif_overview(), qc_compare(), boring_map() (fetch_basemap() imagery), depth_slice_map(), chart_*() site charts export_site_charts(). process_site() pipeline site_report() renderer: self-contained HTML, Markdown, PDF, per-boring logs PDF. lif_simulate() synthetic site generator; bundled demo dataset built . Documentation: getting-started guide plus articles raw file format, editing audit trail, plot gallery, site report; README rendered example figures.
